causes.label: demand
causes.quote: Demand was high during the evening peak, driven by extremely cold weather increasing heating requirements.

causes.label: scheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: Almost 3,300 MW of that capacity was on planned outage, which was expected as generators generally undertake maintenance in autumn before returning to service for the winter peak from mid- to late-June.

causes.label: unscheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: The remaining 1,800 MW of capacity of unplanned outages was all in Queensland. Most of this capacity had been out since the significant failure of the Callide C 4 unit on 25 May 2021

causes.label: unscheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: Another 700 MW was unavailable due to technical issues - mostly at Liddell and Gladstone power stations.

causes.label: fcas_co_optimisation
causes.quote: This trade-off between the provision of FCAS and energy effectively reduced low priced capacity by up to 60 MW and contributed to high dispatch prices.

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: No further imports could be sourced from Victoria, as the VIC-NSW interconnector was already operating at or close to its nominal limit.
